findings.title: Materials' 129% earnings bet looks stretched
findings.body: Materials' forward P/E sits at the 23rd percentile while its trailing multiple is at the 89th, a 66-point gap. Analysts are underwriting 129 percent earnings growth, which would be a remarkable turnaround for a sector whose trailing earnings have kept its reported multiple that rich.

findings.title: Real Estate's forward multiple collapses despite flat earnings
findings.body: Real Estate's forward P/E fell 44 percentile points in a month to the 8th percentile, yet its implied earnings growth is only a 3 percent decline. The forward multiple now sits below the trailing one, suggesting the market is repricing the sector on risk rather than on a fundamental earnings cliff.

findings.title: Consumer Staples' cheap forward hides rich trailing
findings.body: Consumer Staples trades at a forward P/E in the 13th percentile but a trailing multiple in the 61st, a 48-point gap. The market is paying up for stability in the trailing lens while forward estimates imply only 39 percent growth, a disconnect that points to defensive demand rather than earnings optimism.
